name: brigadier-ai
description: An ACP hub: one client drives whichever coding agents are installed, isolates each unit of work, and composes them.

scripts.build: bun run licenses --check && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile dist/brigadier && bun run license-gate --require-binary
scripts.gates: bun run typecheck && bun run test-gate && bun run claims && bun run build
